## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Claude Desktop 将配置定义拆分到独立模块后，管理器误报第三方 API 和实例代理不可用的问题。已对本机安装的 6.28899.6 进行只读配置检测。
- The manager now recognizes the gateway and proxy configuration schema when Claude Desktop loads it from a separate module. The capability checks passed against an installed copy of 6.28899.6.

- 编辑实例并切换供应商密钥时，只要新密钥仍列出原模型，就保留该模型。若新密钥没有模型列表，允许手动填写模型的连接也会保留原值。
- When editing an instance, switching provider keys preserves the selected model if the new key lists it. Connections that accept a custom model also retain it when the new key has no model list.
- 桌面兼容测试现在使用临时应用副本，在后台启动前检查禁用更新的设置。新增技能选择测试，核对同一对话的后续请求是否同时包含所选技能正文和上一轮回复。
- Desktop compatibility tests now run a disposable app copy in the background with the updater disabled. The skill-picker test checks that the next request in an existing conversation contains both the selected skill and the previous reply.

## 使用与升级 / Installation

在已验证的 Codex 桌面版本中，在原对话输入 `$` 加技能名即可选择技能。`/` 打开聊天命令菜单。

In the verified Codex desktop build, enter `$` followed by the skill name in the current conversation. The `/` menu lists chat commands.

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG 和 ZIP。下载后可用同一 Release 的 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 核对，再将 Agent Manager Lite 放入“应用程序”。本版采用手动安装，未提供 Developer ID 签名或 Apple 公证。

The DMG and ZIP target macOS on Apple Silicon (arm64). Verify the download against `SHA256SUMS.txt` from this release before installing Agent Manager Lite in Applications. Installation is manual. These packages do not carry a Developer ID signature or Apple notarization.

## 验证 / Verification

已用 Codex 桌面 `26.1120.41243` 验证技能选择，并用该版本内置的客户端、测试密钥和本机模拟上游验证切换密钥后恢复同一对话的 Responses 与 Chat Completions 请求。

The skill picker was exercised in Codex desktop `26.1120.41243`. Its bundled client was also tested with disposable keys and loopback Responses and Chat Completions providers while resuming the same thread after a key change.

来源标签 / Source tag: `v0.15.38`. See the release assets for the installer checksums.
